'''Mark V Power Guards''' were the final model of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] augmented with the [[Power Guard Enhancement System]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] employed several Mark V Power Guards on board his [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']].
